name: IdeaScale Whiteboard (Fresco entry)
description_en:
The original Fresco website now redirects to IdeaScale Whiteboard, a visual collaboration tool inside IdeaScale’s community/workspace model. A canvas holds notes, shapes, drawings and board-linked tasks, while a separate Task Manager organizes that work across accessible boards in the same community.

This profile covers the Whiteboard product rather than all IdeaScale innovation-management or AI capabilities. Access depends on roles, campaign/community scope and board sharing; the current permission guide narrows earlier all-user release language. Limited free access is documented, while unlimited Whiteboard pricing requires sales confirmation.
description_zh:
原 Fresco 官网现跳转至 IdeaScale Whiteboard，即 IdeaScale 社区／工作区模型内的可视协作工具。画布容纳便签、形状、绘图及关联看板的任务，独立 Task Manager 则在同一社区可访问看板间组织工作。

本档案只覆盖 Whiteboard，不混入全部 IdeaScale 创新管理或 AI 能力。访问取决于角色、活动／社区范围和看板共享；当前权限指南收窄了早期面向所有用户的发布文字。文档提供有限免费访问，无限 Whiteboard 价格需销售确认。

core_features.explanation_en: Arrange notes, shapes, text, drawings and representations of board tasks.
core_features.explanation_zh: 排列便签、形状、文本、绘图及看板任务的可视呈现。

core_features.name_zh: 关联看板的任务管理器
core_features.explanation_en: Every task belongs to a board; assignees must have edit access to that board.
core_features.explanation_zh: 每个任务归属一个看板，负责人须有该看板编辑权。

core_features.explanation_en: Role eligibility, community/campaign access and per-board settings affect availability.
core_features.explanation_zh: 角色资格、社区／活动访问及逐看板设置共同影响可用性。

en: Facilitate one workshop and convert a selected observation into a board-linked action with an eligible editor.
zh: 引导一个工作坊，把选定观察转为关联看板的行动，并选择具资格编辑者负责。
use_cases.basis: Original proposed evaluation; no workshop execution or customer evidence.

Workspace model.en: Whiteboard is reached inside IdeaScale; task data is community-scoped. Visual export is not a proven full backup or self-hosting package.
Workspace model.zh: Whiteboard 在 IdeaScale 内访问，任务数据按社区划分；可视导出不是经证明的完整备份或自托管包。

steps.en: Confirm workspace/community role and plan entitlement, then create one non-sensitive board.
steps.zh: 确认工作区／社区角色及套餐资格，再建立一个非敏感看板。

steps.en: Check board/campaign visibility, a task assignee’s wider edit access and an export before live collaboration.
steps.zh: 真实协作前核对看板／活动可见性、任务负责人更广的编辑权限及导出。

items.zh: 当前角色文字收窄早期全员访问；任务负责人需有看板编辑权，并可访问全部关联任务。

sections.title_en: Treat the redirect as the current product entry
sections.title_zh: 把跳转后的页面作为当前产品入口
sections.en:
The actual frescopad.com redirect leads to IdeaScale’s Whiteboard page. The former record’s generic Fresco description is superseded by that current scope, with the original slug retained. No duplicate ideascale.com identity was found in the baseline catalog.

The page combines a drawing canvas with Kanban-style tasks and describes deeper innovation-workflow integration as Coming Soon. Do not import the parent platform’s complete campaign lifecycle, analytics or integration catalog into this one feature. Legacy Fresco account migration and stored-board continuity were not verified.
sections.zh:
实际 frescopad.com 跳转到 IdeaScale 的 Whiteboard 页面，本稿用这一当前范围替代旧条目的通用 Fresco 介绍，保留原 slug。基线目录未发现重复 ideascale.com 身份。

页面把绘图画布与 Kanban 式任务组合，并将更深入的创新流程集成标为 Coming Soon。不能把父平台完整活动生命周期、分析或集成目录都归入这个功能。旧 Fresco 账户迁移及已存看板连续性尚未核实。

sections.title_en: Turn a selected board item into accountable work
sections.title_zh: 把选定看板内容转成可负责的工作
sections.en:
For a proposed workshop, put observations on notes, connect related items with shapes and choose one next action. Create its Task Manager entry with a board, assignee, status and due date, then place the task representation on the canvas. A diagram’s position lock is a layout control, not an access or approval lock.

The canvas guide documents live cursors, chat, drawing and undo/redo. These help collaboration but do not prove a team has agreed on the action. Inspect the task’s actual fields and the intended assignee rather than assuming a drawn box becomes an assigned task automatically. This workflow was not executed.
sections.zh:
假设开展工作坊，可把观察写在便签上，用形状连接相关项，再选择一个下一步行动。在 Task Manager 中建立任务，设置看板、负责人、状态及到期日，再把任务呈现放入画布。图形位置锁定是布局控制，不是权限或批准锁。

画布指南描述实时光标、聊天、绘图及撤销／重做，有助于协作但不证明团队已同意行动。应检查真实任务字段及目标负责人，不应认为画出的框自动成为已分配任务。本流程未执行。

sections.title_en: Assigning one task grants no task-only privacy boundary
sections.title_zh: 分配一个任务不构成仅该任务的私密边界
sections.en:
The task guide makes Board mandatory and only permits an assignee with edit access to that board. A board editor can access, edit and comment on all tasks linked to the board, not just the one assigned to them. Tasks do not cross community boundaries.

For client-separated work, choose the board and community deliberately before assigning anyone. The dashboard opens a broader task scope than a board-specific view; filters change presentation, not permissions. My Tasks is useful for personal focus but is not a security boundary. Missing work may reflect a board-access restriction or an active view filter rather than a deleted task.
sections.zh:
任务指南要求 Board 必填，只允许选择具有该看板编辑权的负责人。看板编辑者可访问、编辑及评论关联该看板的全部任务，而不限于分配给自己的一个任务。任务也不会跨社区共享。

要隔离客户工作，应在分配人员前明确选择看板和社区。仪表盘默认任务范围比看板视图更广，筛选改变显示，不改变权限。My Tasks 有助于个人聚焦，但不是安全边界；找不到任务可能源于看板访问限制或视图筛选，不一定是任务已删。

sections.title_en: Check current eligibility before sharing a link
sections.title_zh: 共享链接前先核对当前资格
sections.en:
The October15,2026 permission guide says ordinary members need an administrator, moderator or custom role to access Whiteboard on either Free or Paid. That is narrower than the all-user wording in the December2024 release and in parts of the same overview. Confirm the intended account’s entitlement rather than choosing the broadest sentence.

Within a board, sharing-link, community-member and individual-member settings interact; individual access overrides the community setting. Removing a member removes access to the board and related tasks, while administrator/moderator authority can extend beyond individual invitations. A restricted board should therefore not be presented as private from all administrators. Check the actual role and campaign scope with harmless material.
sections.zh:
2026年10月15日权限指南称，普通成员在 Free 和 Paid 都需要管理员、版主或自定义角色才能访问 Whiteboard，这比2024年12月发布及同一概览部分段落的全员措辞更窄。应确认目标账户资格，不挑选最宽泛句子作为结论。

看板内共享链接、社区成员及单独成员设置共同作用，单独成员权限覆盖社区设置。移除成员会使其失去看板及相关任务访问，管理员／版主权力则可超出单独邀请。因此不能将受限看板描述为对所有管理员都私密；应以无害材料核对真实角色和活动范围。

sections.title_en: A personal folder and a visual export preserve different things
sections.title_zh: 个人文件夹与可视导出保留不同内容
sections.en:
The dashboard guide says folders are personal organization rather than shared containers; moving a board into a folder does not remove it from the dashboard. Board-sharing settings still govern the board.

Canvas controls document image/PDF export and undo/redo. A visual snapshot can preserve a workshop outcome, but it is not demonstrated recovery of editable objects, task history, permissions or community structure. Before relying on a board as the only record, inspect an exit copy and confirm how an accidentally deleted board would be restored. A complete round-trip backup and deletion-retention window were not established by these guides.
sections.zh:
仪表盘指南称，文件夹用于个人组织，不是共享容器；看板移入文件夹后仍在仪表盘出现，看板访问仍由共享设置决定。

画布控件描述图片／PDF 导出及撤销／重做。可视快照可保留工作坊成果，但不证明能恢复可编辑对象、任务历史、权限或社区结构。将看板作为唯一记录前，应检查退出副本，并确认误删看板的恢复方式。指南未确立完整往返备份或删除保留窗口。

sections.title_en: Limited free Whiteboard access is not every IdeaScale feature
sections.title_zh: 有限免费白板不包含全部 IdeaScale 功能
sections.en:
The current permission article allows one board per eligible member on Free and unlimited creation on Paid. The product page says its free version is available across licenses and directs unlimited upgrades to sales; an exact separate Whiteboard amount, billing unit and checkout were not established. The older release’s ten-person simultaneous limit is dated and is not promoted to a current universal capacity guarantee.

The October9,2026 AI overview still lists Whiteboard AI as forthcoming. Available IdeaScale AI Chatbot and writing assistance have their own scope and do not prove AI generation on the canvas. Likewise, a Coming Soon integration label is not a released connector. Verify plan access and the exact feature in the intended workspace.
sections.zh:
当前权限文章规定，Free 每名具资格成员一个看板，Paid 可无限创建。产品页称免费版适用于各许可证，无限升级需联系销售；准确独立 Whiteboard 金额、计费单位及结账尚未确立。旧发布的十人同时协作上限有明确历史日期，未提升为当前普遍容量保证。

2026年10月9日 AI 概览仍把 Whiteboard AI 列为待推出。已提供的 IdeaScale AI Chatbot 和写作助手各有范围，不证明画布具有 AI 生成功能。同样，Coming Soon 集成不等于已发布连接器。需在目标工作区核对套餐资格及具体功能。

sections.title_en: Keep the exit copy before a subscription cancellation
sections.title_zh: 取消订阅前先保留退出副本
sections.en:
The general IdeaScale terms distinguish user content ownership from service rights and put backup responsibility on the user. They describe automatic subscription renewal, non-refundable fees and immediate content deletion on cancellation. An executed enterprise agreement can govern instead, so do not assume the same cancellation path for every organization.

Use Whiteboard to connect facilitated visual discussion with board-scoped follow-up when those role and data conditions fit. Do not treat its visual export as a tested restore or assume a freely redistributable application backend. No account, campaign, board, task, export, AI request, payment or cancellation was performed in this research.
sections.zh:
一般 IdeaScale 条款区分用户内容所有权和服务权利，要求用户负责备份，并描述订阅自动续订、不退款及取消后立即删除内容。已签 Enterprise 协议可另行管辖，因此不能假定所有组织走相同取消路径。

角色及数据条件适合时，可用 Whiteboard 把引导式可视讨论连接到看板范围内的跟进。不应把可视导出当作已测恢复，也不假定有可自由再分发的应用后端。本研究未执行账户、活动、看板、任务、导出、AI 请求、付款或取消。
